meta.title: Saladín Industria Gráfica | Folding cartons, litho-laminated packaging & labels — Dominican Republic
meta.description: Dominican industrial printer with 45+ years: printed folding cartons, litho-laminated packaging (E, B and C flutes) and adhesive labels. ISO 9001:2015, G7 color management. Request your quote.

hero.title: Packaging that prints value
hero.subtitle: We pioneered litho-laminated corrugated packaging in the Dominican Republic. Three plants, 120 employees and 45+ years turning our clients' vision into packaging that sells.
hero.imageLabel: PHOTO: offset press running, Herrera plant

items.title: Printed folding cartons
items.desc: Offset-printed paperboard cartons for food, pharma and consumer goods. Our origin in 1979 and our lifelong specialty.
items.imageLabel: PHOTO: finished folding cartons, several industries

items.title: Litho-laminated micro-corrugated board
items.desc: High-quality offset printing laminated onto micro-corrugated board in E, B and C flutes. Produced at our SPACK plant in the Las Américas Free Trade Zone.
items.imageLabel: PHOTO: finished litho-laminated boxes, Las Américas plant

items.title: Adhesive labels
items.desc: Pressure-sensitive labels that complete your product's packaging system, with the same G7 color control as everything we print.

spack.title: SPACK: export-grade litho-lamination
spack.desc: In 2022 we expanded into the Las Américas Free Trade Zone industrial park to produce high-quality litho-laminated packaging under our SPACK brand — built for brands exporting from the Caribbean.
bullets: E, B and C flutes to match the protection and finish your product demands
Free-trade-zone regime, ideal for exporting clients

clients.title: Brands that have trusted us
clients.desc: Since the 1990s we have produced for leaders such as Nestlé, Colgate, Ray-o-Vac (Spectrum Brands), Unilever and Kimberly-Clark. That level of demand shaped our quality culture.

finalCta.title: If you can imagine it, we can make it happen
finalCta.desc: Tell us what you need to pack. We reply with a technical and commercial proposal.
